attrs.note: datasheet - style, material, colour, environment and the included accessories are the specification table of the FS 1&2RU Horizontal Single Sided Manager datasheet; RoHS and ISO 9001 are its Standards Compliance list.

base-shape.note: drawing - THE BASE BEHIND THE EARS IS BOWED in the top view, as on USCMH-SFDABS1U, 35.5 deep at the middle. It is drawn as a straight box the full 35.5 deep and the full height; the X-ribs on it are not drawn.

bottom.note: drawing - the renders draw the same fingers along the bottom as along the top; the bottom is the top again.

capacity.note: estimated - 116 cables, FS states none for the USCMH finger ducts. The channel clear cross-section, 66.8 mm high (the duct guide) by 69.75 mm deep (the well floor to the underside of the cover), divided by 39.9 mm2 a cable: the pooled ratio of the three FS ABS finger ducts whose capacity FS does state (CMH-SFD1U 48 in 1850 mm2, CMH-DFD1U 96 in 3700, CMH-SFD2U 124 in 5143). Those agree to within 8%, which is this figure's uncertainty at best; this is a different moulding. Across every FS manager the ratio runs 38.5 to 82.8 (the HD and UHD lines scale per rack unit), so it is fitted on the ABS ducts only.

chassis.note: drawing - THE BODY BETWEEN THE EARS. The specification table gives 88.0 x 482.2 x 107.0 mm (3.46 x 18.98 x 4.21 in) and the front view 88.8 high and 484.84 across the cover; 88.8 is taken. The width between the ear folds is the USCMH-SFDABS1U's 436.3, whose top view this one repeats; the ears are not drawn. `depth` STATES THE VENDOR OVERALL 107.0: THE PRODUCT SELECTOR'S 2.81 in [71 mm] IS THE PROJECTION IN FRONT OF THE EARS, the 71.45 of the top view and the 2.81 in on the dimensioned render, not the depth; the table's 4.21 in and the drawing's 107.00 agree, and the ribbed base stands 35.55 behind the ears.

color.note: estimated - "Color: Black". Every image FS publishes of the part is a render; it is drawn in CMH-SFD1U's shades, the cover a little lighter than the duct.

fingers.note: drawing - the top view: nine fingers a row, the middle seven on a 53.9 mm pitch with the middle one on the middle of the duct, 19.5 wide, and the two end fingers centred 207.8 from the middle at mid-length. The end fingers are swept toward the middle in the top view; they are drawn straight, centred 202.15 from the middle so that their 32 mm tips end flush with the ends of the duct, 5.65 inside where their mid-length reads.

front.note: drawing - the cover, fitted, 22.36 deep, the 71.45 to the front less the 49.09 (Ref) from the ears to the back of the cover. The finger walls are placed 1.0 inside the top and bottom of the duct and 10 thick, estimated: the renders show the upper row's roots in the top quarter of the plate. The `duct` guide is the channel between them over the full width, on the top view's pitch and gap.

full-depth.note: `full-depth: false` - the fingers and cover stand 71.45 mm in front of the plane of the ears and the base 35.55 behind it (the top view), so the rear face of its rack unit stays free for another part.

guides.note: estimated - the duct on the front view is the channel between the finger walls, run across the rack; the finger pitch and gap are the top view figures, the channel height the estimated wall placement above.

left.note: drawing - the side view along the depth: the base, the two rows of fingers, and the cover's edges over their tips. The duct is open at both ends, and nothing is built across them.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE VENDOR DRAWING. The FS 1&2RU Horizontal Single Sided Manager datasheet (USCMH-SFDABS1U and -2U) has a specification table and, per model, a top view, a front view and a side view in millimetres. Rendered at 600 dpi, the front view is 4.14 px/mm across its 484.84 and 4.17 down its 88.8, under 1 per cent apart, so it is orthographic. The top view is the USCMH-SFDABS1U top view with a deeper cover: 107.00 (Ref) overall, 71.45 in front of the plane of the ears and 49.09 (Ref) from the ears to the back of the cover; the side view's 75.80 is the 71.45 plus the same 4.35 as on the 1U. The renders of #317017 are the second reading; gallery image 5 is the front with the cover off, straight on, and its ear holes 76 mm apart read 3.16 px/mm down against 3.16 across.

rear.note: photo-measured - the back of the base with the pass-through windows of the front, which the renders show the background through: 101.3 x 15.8 at [66.25, 20.6]; 101.3 x 15.8 at [268.75, 20.6]; 101.3 x 15.8 at [66.25, 52.2]; 101.3 x 15.8 at [268.75, 52.2]. The back is built as plates round them, sunk 0.05 inside the rear face, as CMH-SFD1U 0.1.2 builds its back. The window heights are estimated where the fingers hide their lower edges.

shell.note: drawing - A HOLLOW DUCT, NOT A BOX, built as CMH-SFD1U is: the base plate on the front view as a well 71.25 deep whose floor is open at the pass-through windows, the two rows of fingers standing in it, the cover in it across the finger tips, which lifts off and opens the channel, and the base behind the ears closed by plates sunk just inside the rear, top, bottom and side faces. The channel, the slots between the fingers and the two ends are open air.

thickness.note: estimated - no FS document states a wall gauge for the ABS moulding; 10 is the estimated thickness of a finger across the height of the duct, and the plates and the cover are thinner, each in its own part.

top.note: drawing - the top view, rear at y=0: the base 35.55 deep behind the plane of the ears, the fingers to the back of the cover with the slots dark between them, and the cover over the last 22.36.
